recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-20002; any future change to the underlying security category code/display should be handled under the later issue family and Extension Pack vocabulary source of truth.

FHIR-54173 later revisited the not-classified label and resolved that the vocabulary display should be No Dominant Category while the code remains not-classified in the Extension Pack.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/resourcelist.html links to security.html#SecPrivConsiderations, and current source/security.html uses the dominant-use wording and the No Dominant Category heading.
